text.tspan: The story I'll be telling you today is about how this mechanism of transcriptional control,
despite being constantly bombarded on all sides by randomly moving molecules,
despite the small differences of concentration which it must distinguish in a short time,
could still exert fine control on gene expression in a biologically and physically plausible way.
I will show you how with generic biological components, making use of fascinating physical
effects, sensitivity to small changes in concentration can be amplified and controlled.
